video_title: The NFL Contender That Needs Maxx Crosby the Most

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Are first-round picks worth trading for defensive players mid-season?
quotes.excerpt: If I'm trading first-round picks, fourth-round picks, second, third and all those different things, that's telling me I'm ready to win now.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Are defensive players that are getting first-round picks worth the haul at this point of the season?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: It depends on the player. We just watched Jeffery Simmons go crazy. Against Monday night, he had a sack, a number of tackles, tackle for loss. If I'm trading first-round picks, fourth-round picks, second, third and all those different things, that's telling me I'm ready to win now. I got all the other pieces and I got young talent that I'm going to have for a few years. So the draft is not going to give us anything really to change what we got right now. We're ready to go right now.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading for impact players signals a team's readiness to win now
quotes.excerpt: When Miles Garrett got traded, Trumaine McDuffie got paid, they brought Aaron Donald back, that's telling everybody we're ready to win now.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: When Miles Garrett got traded, Trumaine McDuffie got paid, they brought Aaron Donald back, that's telling everybody we're ready to win now. You get Stafford for another year, we're ready to win now. They gave up a first, a second, a third and Jared Goff for Miles Garrett. They gave up a lot. That's saying we're ready to go now and you brought Aaron Donald back.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Can a singular player on either side of the ball completely change a team into a Super Bowl contender?

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Impact players in key positions can turn teams into contenders
quotes.excerpt: Peyton Manning did it with Denver when he went there. Tom Brady did it when he left New England and went to Tampa.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: Peyton Manning did it with Denver when he went there. Tom Brady did it when he left New England and went to Tampa. First year, won a Super Bowl. Von Miller went to Denver when he left, you know, and went to Denver. There's a lot of players that it's just a couple missing pieces, but it has to be at an impactful position.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Chiefs need pass rush help to remain contenders
quotes.excerpt: The Chiefs are one of the worst teams in pass rush right now for whatever reason.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Is there any team out there you feel like can use a Maxx Crosby at this point?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: The Chiefs. The Chiefs are one of the worst teams in pass rush right now for whatever reason. So the Chiefs got interior alignment problems on the offense, their left tackle is out, they benched their guard, and they're one of the teams at the bottom of the league at pass rush. So that's another team that you say, can he come right now and help? Yeah, that's a veteran team, well-coached team, talent. Maxx Crosby come over here, right now you're a contender.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Chiefs' championship window is still open with Mahomes
quotes.excerpt: When you have a well-coached team, they figure it out. They know how to make adjustments.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Is this team a little past their window?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: No, I'm going to say no. I think when you have a well-coached team, they figure it out. They know how to make adjustments. They've done it in the past. And are they the same team they were maybe three or four years ago? Probably not. Everybody points, like I said, to the receivers. You got Rice, who's their most productive receiver, and then you got Royals, and you got some of the other receivers that are young, second, third year players that haven't produced worthy. So when you look at their playmakers, it's Mahomes, Kenneth Walker, Kelsey, and Rice.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Chiefs must prioritize offensive line protection for Mahomes
quotes.excerpt: You got to protect Patrick Mahomes. We've seen, we don't need, he's coming off an injury.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: If you were going to do something for that team that helped them for a push, would it be on the offense side or the defense side of the ball?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: Probably the offense, because I think that's where they're having their issues. The protection, first of all. O-line. You got to protect Patrick Mahomes. We've seen, we don't need, he's coming off an injury. So you don't need him in harm's way. You got to keep him secure to keep him to be able to throw and deliver the ball from the pocket. We know he can improvise. We know he has one of the livest arms in the game. So I would say you got to fix that O-line. That O-line is going to help not only him, protect him and give him more time in the passing game, but also in the running game.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Buffalo Bills need secondary help to stop opponents
quotes.excerpt: At some point, you can't get in every game and be in a shootout.
quotes.quote: Buffalo, probably the defense, secondary. If you want to point out, if you want to nick pick, they got to get better. I think when the trade comes, you'll see them probably trade for a defender to help the back end, because at some point, you can't get in every game and be in a shootout. And although Josh Allen, this offense is great and they can score points and they can make this miraculous plays, you got to be able to stop people. And I think defensively on the back end, if you're if you're saying, hey, what's that missing piece or what we need to do, that's another great team for Maxx Crosby.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: A team cannot win a championship without a reliable quarterback
quotes.excerpt: You can't win without a quarterback. Key. You can't win.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Would you start on the offensive side with the quarterback or would you start with the defense up front?

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: You can't win without a quarterback. Key. You can't win. I can I can shut you down and and hold you to 12, 14 points, if you can't score, don't matter.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Caleb Williams has shown significant growth in his second year
quotes.excerpt: He understood the assignment and Ben Johnson, he helped by taking the ball out of his hands.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: Caleb is, he understood the assignment and Ben Johnson, he helped by taking the ball out of his hands, sort of, because he runs the ball 40 plus percent of the time. And he got Caleb to understand that you can play within the offense and you don't have to be the entire offense. And that takes that Superman mentality away where you have to do everything. Lean on your players. Yeah, we're going to lean on your athletic ability, we're going to lean on your talent, but you don't have to press as much.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: He's made a huge jump this year.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Jacksonville Jaguars are a well-balanced team to watch
quotes.excerpt: The Jaguars are one. The Jacksonville Jaguars. We haven't given them enough respect. The Jags are playing well.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Give me top two you feel like.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: I mean right now you got to go with Buffalo just because what they're 6-1 and you see Kansas City kind of struggling a little bit. The Patriots are on the way up, whether they're 5-3. The Jags are one. The Jacksonville Jaguars. We haven't given them enough respect. The Jags are playing well. Sunshine is out there throwing that bitch around, boy. Well-balanced. Well-balanced, run game, passing game, defense. And if everybody keeps talking about everybody else, just watch what they're doing.
